title: Wow! My Box Is Open! 📦 Open and Close with Baby Jimmy | Learn Opposites | Crayon Babies
description:
Wow! Baby Jimmy's red box pops open all by itself! 📦✨ Sing along with Jimmy and learn the opposites OPEN and CLOSE – with a box, your hands and your mouth!

🎬 What happens in this video:
😮 "Wow! Look! My box is open!" – sparkles fly out!
📦 Open, close! Open, close! Jimmy shuts the lid and opens it again
🖐️ Open your hands – wiggle, wiggle! Close your hands – squeeze, squeeze!
😮 Open your mouth – ahh, ahh, ahh! Close your mouth – mmm, mmm, mmm!
🤔 "My box... open or closed?" – can you say it? Closed! Yay!
👋 Open, close! Bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: opposites • open • close • closed • hands • mouth

🎶 Voices only: children singing, humming and clapping with a soft hand drum – no other musical instruments.

A fun opposites song for toddlers and preschoolers: Baby Jimmy shows open and close with a little red box, then everyone copies him – open your hands, close your hands, open your mouth, close your mouth – and answers his question. Great for first English words, listening and copy-me play at home.
